subject: Plan reconsolidation and seat trade-off for NovaMed
messages:
From: Erin Cole <erin@novamed.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Clarify plan: downgrade seats but keep features?

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look great and the audit/logging features are what our security team needs. We are trying to tighten Q1 spend and I wanted to check two things before we route this through procurement:

1) We currently budgeted for 25 concurrent seats on the Mid tier. Can we move to 16 seats on the same Mid feature bundle and keep the burst capacity for scheduled job windows?
2) If we drop seats but keep the same feature set (observability + KV caching + prefix caching), what does the net ARR look like and can you preserve the 10% onboarding credit we discussed?

Procurement wants a short summary (line items + one-sheet) and a clear path for upsizing later without penalties. Can you send something we can attach to the PO request?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if that’s easier.

—Erin
Director of Platform Eng, NovaMed Health
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Cole <erin@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify plan: downgrade seats but keep features?

Erin —

Short answer: yes, we can do the seat reduction without removing the observability and caching features. I attached a one-sheet and an updated proposal that shows the two scenarios (16 seats vs 25 seats) and the burst add-on for scheduled jobs. Highlights:

- Mid tier (feature parity) with 25 seats: $34,500/mo (baseline)
- Mid tier with 16 seats + burst add-on (1.5x burst capacity during windows): $23,200/mo
- We can keep your 10% onboarding credit applied to the first 3 months on either option.

Notes on upsizing: we allow seat increases at any time; pricing will honor the committed rate for the first 12 months for the active tier, and we’ll prorate any added seats. No long-term penalty.

Karthik — can you confirm whether we can extend the onboarding credit to 4 months if procurement signs within 7 days? Also looping Ben for approval on the burst concession (we normally price bursts separately).

If it helps, I’m free at 1pm PT for a quick call.

Best,
Aisha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Proposal_NovaMed_v3.pdf (pdf), pricing_table_purchaseorder.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, Erin Cole <erin@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T13:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify plan: downgrade seats but keep features?

Thanks Aisha / Erin —

I reviewed the numbers and ran this against our pricing guardrails. We can expand the onboarding credit to 4 months if NovaMed commits to a 12-month term on the reduced-seat Mid tier. For the burst concession: we can include 1.5x burst at no additional recurring charge for the first 90 days as a welcome concession; after that it will revert to the standard burst addon rate unless you convert the burst usage into reserved capacity.

Ben — can you sign off on the temporary burst waiver? This is within the standard commercial flex for mid-market deals but I want to make sure we’re aligned on precedent.

Erin — I also added a short addendum to the proposal that spells out seat-proration and the upsizing process (no penalties, 30-day notice for planned seat rebalancing). See attached proposal. If procurement needs a single-line PO amount we can provide a 12-month annualized figure and an optional monthly billing schedule.

Next steps:
- Erin/procurement: confirm 12-month term to unlock 4-month onboarding credit
- Aisha: get Ben's sign-off on burst concession and finalize DocuSign

Regards,
Karthik
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-19T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify plan: downgrade seats but keep features?

Karthik / Aisha —

This is fine to approve. The 90-day temporary burst concession is acceptable for NovaMed given the upsell potential and observability credits. Confirm the following before sending final DocuSign:

- Add explicit clause: "Temporary burst concession: 1.5x burst capacity included at no recurring charge for first 90 days; thereafter, standard burst pricing applies unless converted to reserved capacity."
- Add onboarding credit clause: "10% onboarding credit applied to first invoice; 4% additional credit (total 14%) applied if 12-month term is signed within 7 days of proposal delivery."

Aisha — please push the finalized proposal to DocuSign and copy me when sent. Erin — once signed, we’ll schedule a short handover with solutions engineering to map the job windows for burst usage.

Ben
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
